source.detail: Self-described as 'a distinguished investment company entrusted with managing the wealth of the Al Majdouie family', running private equity, marketable securities and real estate on a Sharia-compliant basis. ⚠ Distinct from Almajdouie Holding, the family's logistics and automotive operating conglomerate — the investment arm is the prospect, not the group. Formerly branded Almajdouie Invest. Evidence: https://majd.sa/
